name: Hair restoration clinic

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Free hair consult
services.story: The main story: a free 30-minute consult with Sofia. Nothing is taken, and there's nothing to pay.

services.name: Follow-up visit
services.story: A $150 follow-up visit. A card is saved for the $20 missed-visit fee, which the owner confirms before any charge, and Alex pays at the front desk.

services.name: Transplant day (example)
services.story: A transplant day quoted at $6,800. A $1,500 deposit now counts toward it, and the $5,300 rest is paid at the clinic's front desk before the day starts.

services.name: PRP, 3-session pack
services.story: A 3-session PRP pack, $1,200, paid in full when booked. Nothing more is owed.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Ivy (nurse practitioner) and Leo (registered nurse), who see patients at home under Sofia's orders

services.name: PRP session at home
services.story: The main story: a $350 PRP session at Alex's home. A card is saved for the $89 missed-visit fee, and the card is charged when Ivy texts DONE, after Alex says yes to the price.

services.name: PRP pack at home (3 sessions)
services.story: A 3-session PRP pack at home, $1,000, paid in full when booked.

services_shape: a free consult, then set visits: follow-ups and PRP sessions are paid by the patient; a transplant day is quoted in writing first, with a deposit toward it; anything added at the visit needs the patient's yes first
questions_before_times: consult, follow-up, PRP or a transplant day
which visit: the clinic's own visit types only, never a scalp symptom or a photo typed into the AI
paying yourself, or a health plan (its name only)
for a video visit: the state the patient will be in
join the list for a sooner time
safety_stop: swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat, or trouble breathing (for example after a new medicine or a numbing shot)
bleeding that won't stop after 20 minutes of firm pressure
a fast-spreading red scalp with pus or a fever after a procedure
a swallowed medicine, or too much of one
first_steps: A written quote for a transplant day and self-pay work
A consult before a transplant day
license: the owner's word: each physician and physician assistant holds their own license, and the clinic its registration, where the state's form asks; Rosie never looks a license up
staff_skills: Sofia (physician): consults, transplant days, PRP; Noah (physician assistant): follow-ups, PRP where the state allows; Ivy (nurse practitioner) and Leo (registered nurse): scalp care visits at home under Sofia's orders; the clinic's technicians: graft work only under the physician's direct supervision, never a consult or a price; the front desk: no clinical OKs
messages_never: texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the procedure, the plan, the reason, a scalp detail, photos or results; flow A's texts drop the physician's name; at a home visit the clinician's name stays, for the door check
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
